line.name: E.P. Carrillo Cardinal Impact Maduro
line.background_text: Cardinal Impact is the 2016 relaunch of E.P. Carrillo's original 2012 Cardinal line, rebuilt with modified blends and box-pressed construction. Offered in two wrapper expressions: a Natural (Ecuadorian Sumatra, already on the site) and this Maduro (Connecticut Broadleaf), made at Tabacalera La Alianza.

research_notes: Confirmed genuinely distinct SKU family from the site's Cardinal Impact Natural - same line/relaunch, different wrapper leaf.

research_sources.supports: blend, sizes, 2016 relaunch, relationship to Natural
